import sqlite3

con = sqlite3.connect("data/app.db")

# 1. Table exists

# 2. Column spec
expected = [
    ("id", "INTEGER"),
    ("customer_id", "INTEGER"),

assert "CHECK (amount >= 0)" in sql, "amount check constraint missing"
assert "DEFAULT (datetime('now'))" in sql, "created_at default missing"
print("RULES    id=PK autoincrement | all NOT NULL | amount CHECK>=0 | created_at DEFAULT now")

# 4. Indexes
idx = {r[1] for r in con.execute("PRAGMA index_list(orders)")}
assert {"idx_orders_customer_id", "idx_orders_created_at"} <= idx, f"indexes missing: {idx}"
print("INDEXES  " + ", ".join(sorted(idx)))

# 5. Autoincrement sequence table present (sanity for INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT)
assert "sqlite_sequence" in tables
print("SEQ      sqlite_sequence present")

con.close()
print("\nALL CHECKS PASSED")
EOF"}

    con.execute("INSERT INTO orders (customer_id, amount) VALUES (1, -5)")
    assert False, "negative amount accepted?!"

    pass

# 2. Column spec
expected = [
    ("id", "INTEGER"),
    ("customer_id", "INTEGER"),
    ("amount", "REAL"),
    ("created_at", "TEXT"),
]

actual = [(c[1], c[2]) for c in cols]
assert actual == expected, f"column mismatch: {actual}"
print("COLUMNS  " + ", ".join(f"{n}:{t}" for n, t in actual))

# 3. Constraints
assert cols[0][5] == 1, "id should be primary key"
